title: US automakers could soon be forced to include AM radio for free | TechCrunch
summary: The AM Radio for Every Vehicle Act , which would direct the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration to require automakers to include AM radio in new passenger vehicles as standard equipment, will now head to the Senate.
